27150.name: Retribution Aura

27151.name: Shadow Resistance Aura

27152.name: Frost Resistance Aura

27153.name: Fire Resistance Aura

27160.name: Seal of Light

27166.name: Seal of Wisdom

27216.name: Corruption

27217.name: Drain Soul

27218.name: Curse of Agony

27224.name: Curse of Weakness
27224.description: Target's melee attack power is reduced by 257 for 2 min.  Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

27226.name: Curse of Recklessness
27226.description: Curses the target with recklessness, increasing melee attack power by 135 but reducing armor by 800 for 2 min.  Cursed enemies will not flee and will ignore Fear and Horror effects.  Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

27228.name: Curse of the Elements
